name: Switch
doc: Shows one of up to 6 image inputs, picked by `select` (bind it to core-step, core-section, core-random-walk...). The pick holds for a grid unit and changes on its boundary with a short crossfade; only the shown input (both while fading) renders.

select.doc: which connected input (in port order; wraps past the last one). Bound signals 0..1 map onto 0..5 unless the binding gives a range

quant.doc: the pick is sampled on this grid and holds until the next boundary (tick = every tick, no fade)

fade.doc: crossfade on a change, in beats (clamped to the unit; 0 = cut)

mode.doc: how the new input comes in during the fade
